comment: Devpost cut, about 2:30. Times in seconds. clips name files in public/clips/ (V numbers match the deck's video slots); until a clip exists the rough cut shows a slate. captions are the voiceover, burned in.

beats.caption: This is Spotter. It watched every one of those reps, and said nothing until it mattered.
No voice talking over you mid-set. One kind note while you rest, and a medal that compares you only to yourself.
New? A balanced week that works every muscle group. Recovering? Your range coming back, week by week, in a report you choose to share.
Gym buddies and recovery buddies at your level, with every post checked before anyone sees it.
